name: What warranty or guarantee comes with a sliding door lock replacement?

mainEntity.name: What warranty or guarantee comes with a sliding door lock replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: City Dweller, LLC stands behind the quality of our sliding door lock replacements. We typically offer a warranty on both the installed hardware and our workmanship. The specific duration and terms of the warranty depend on the manufacturer of the lock hardware and our service agreement. We ensure that your new lock functions correctly and provides lasting security. Please inquire about the specific warranty details during your consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: City Dweller, LLC provides a warranty on both the installed sliding door lock hardware and our workmanship. Specific terms depend on the lock manufacturer and service agreement.
